items.comments: Lovely place -  spotless, cozy, and comfortable, with lots of nice sunlight, though it is on a busy, bright street, and so may not be the right place for light sleepers. Cody was super responsive and thoughtful. He even left us travel toothpaste, etc. by the sink!

Cody was a fantastic host, from the beginning we were able to communicate  effectively about the details of the reservation. He was not able to meet us in person but he had a designated person who opened the door for us right we we arrived.  When we arrived at the apartment, we found  a welcome letter, instructions and recommended places to eat and check out, that provided a very nice touch and were very helpful. The apartment itself was absolutely beautiful, I loved the decor and we found it extremely clean and welcoming. It was very comfortable and the bed was fantastic. We really appreciated having that air conditioning during that heat wave. The neighbourhood is very charming and conveniently located by an Interstate that would take you to downtown in about 10 minutes. Also, within walking distance to Freemont, which has lots of restaurants, shops and the Freemont Troll.  During our stay Cody continued to communicate with us and asked how things were going, we really had the most wonderful time and are truly grateful for the opportunity of staying in such a sweet home.
